identity: A UAE Grade-1 Arabic language-arts (اللغة العربية) pupil's book / workbook, the unit مدرستي (My School), running across four lessons: مدرستي, صفي, معلمي ومعلمتي, and the nashid يا مدرستي by صالح هواري. It is page-flow text harvested off the printed page, so it is a stream of display blocks rather than prose: running headers, lesson numbers and titles, comprehension questions, first-person exercise rubrics (أقرأ / أكتب / أصل / أضع / أحلل / أركب / أنطق), a family dialogue with named speakers (ماجد, الأب, الأم, المعلمة, نورة), a rhymed class passage, the nashid itself, values statements, word banks, matching tables and fill-in-the-blank items. Register is plain declarative MSA pitched at six-year-olds: short clauses, almost no subordination, coordination by و rather than by subordinators. Emirati markers confirm the provenance: عيشي بلادي عاش إماراتنا and عجمان.
law: The sentence unit in this text is the PEDAGOGICAL / DISPLAY ITEM, not the syntactic clause chain. The document proves this about itself: it has 118 paragraphs and the great majority hold exactly one item — one question, one rubric, one example sentence, one dialogue turn, one verse line, one word bank. That is the corpus's own rhythm, and I take it as the law. Every unit TYPE I split for is attested somewhere in this same document as a standalone paragraph: questions (⟨24–28⟩), rubrics (⟨446–453⟩), lesson headings الدرس الأول / الثاني / الرابع (⟨43–44⟩, ⟨182–183⟩, ⟨577–578⟩), bare titles مدرستي (⟨46⟩, ⟨92⟩), one-word section labels أحب (⟨164⟩) and أتعرف وأنطق (⟨378–379⟩), single verse lines في الصف أعيش مع الكتب (⟨638–642⟩), and word banks حافلة خلود (⟨801–802⟩). A paragraph carrying two or more such items is therefore a layout-merge artifact of the extraction, and I restore the item boundary inside it. The mirror-image rule constrains me just as hard: I do NOT cut a LABEL away from the thing it labels, because no label of that kind ever stands alone in this document. So speaker names stay glued to their utterance (ماجد ما أجمل مدرستي) — the removed colon is not a terminator; المثال stays glued to its example; القصة الرافدة stays glued to the story title and to the series name قصصي الممتعة; نشيد stays glued to يا مدرستي. Likewise I never cut inside a word bank, because word banks surface whole as paragraphs. Finally, clauses joined inside one utterance by a comma-grade link stay together: بارك الله فيكما فالمعلمة كالأم عطفا وحبا is one sentence, because the ف is explanatory, not a fresh start. Two positive tests I use at every site: (a) does this span end a complete predication or a complete display item, and (b) does a span of exactly this type occur alone as a paragraph elsewhere in the document.
reasoning: GENRE FIRST. Before cutting anything I worked out that this is not prose: paragraph lengths cluster at 4–10 tokens and each such paragraph is one self-contained school item. So the merged paragraphs are the anomaly, and the anomaly is mechanical (two print blocks landing on one extracted line), not authorial. That decides the whole document. Now the contested sites. (1) ⟨137–145⟩ تستحق الآن أطيب طعام | هيا بنا لتناول طعام الغداء — a completed predication followed by a hortative with هيا, which cannot continue a declarative. Cut at 140. Note there are two طعام tokens in this paragraph (140 and 144); the boundary is the FIRST one. hi. (2) ⟨152–162⟩ is the أملأ الفراغ exercise, and its blanks were stripped along with the punctuation, which is why it reads as debris: يقف ماجد أمام _ | ردد التلاميذ عيشي بلادي عاش إماراتنا | _ في المدرسة. Three fill-in items. I cut at 154 and 160 but only at med: the item count is inferable, the exact seams are not, since I cannot see where the blanks stood. (3) ⟨286–289⟩ اللغة العربية مدرستي أتحدث is a stack of three page-furniture elements: subject header, unit title, section label. مدرستي alone is attested as a paragraph (⟨46⟩, ⟨92⟩) and أتحدث recurs as a bare section label at ⟨583⟩, so I cut 288 at med; the seam after العربية (287) is the weakest call in the document and I mark it lo. (4) ⟨311–321⟩ و ما فائدتها | ما الأشياء التي لم توجد قديما في الصف. The follow-up question وما فائدتها was orphaned from its head question ⟨304–309⟩ by a line break; a second ما-question then starts. Two interrogatives cannot share one sentence here. Cut at 313, hi. The same shape drives 334 (ولماذا), 437 (لماذا), 605 (لماذا), 955 (لماذا): a stranded one-word follow-up question is its own sentence, and the corpus corroborates that a single word can be a unit by giving أحب ⟨164⟩ an entire paragraph. (5) ⟨334–342⟩ is the densest merge in the document: ولماذا (question) | أقرأ (section label, cf. أنا أقرأ at ⟨270–271⟩) | معلمي ومعلمتي (the reading text's title, identical to the lesson title at ⟨282–284⟩) | نورة أنا أحب معلمتي كثيرا (dialogue turn). Cuts at 334 hi, 335 and 337 med. Crucially I did NOT cut after نورة: it is a speaker label, and the same restraint applies at 94, 99, 106, 121, 130, 231, 265, 352, 362, 371. (6) The nashid, ⟨611–631⟩. يا مدرستي occurs THREE times in a row here, but ⟨633–636⟩ gives the refrain alone as يا مدرستي يا مدرستي — twofold. So the run parses as title (614–615) plus refrain line (616–619), not as three of anything. That internal evidence is what lets me cut 615 and 619 instead of guessing. The quatrain then runs يا لحن الحب على شفتي / غصني ترعاه يدا أمي / ويطيب بفضل معلمتي, giving 624 and 628. The rubric أنشد بأداء معبر detaches at 613, hi. (7) Verse lines elsewhere are merged in pairs: ⟨644–652⟩ holds في الباحة أغرق في اللعب (which rhymes with الكتب in the standalone line ⟨638–642⟩) plus من حب معلمنا الغالي, so I cut 648; ⟨654–663⟩ holds أتعلم كيف أحب أبي / والفضل يعود لمدرستي / للشاعر صالح هواري, so I cut 657 and 660, the last of those separating the attribution line. All med: the line count is secure but hemistich seams in an unpunctuated nashid are inherently soft. (8) Rubric-on-rubric merges are the easiest calls and I take them all at hi: 201 (أنطق وأميز صوت الحرف الأخير | أنطق وألون ...), 487 (أنطق صوت الحرف الملون وأميزه | أضع هذا هذه ...), 521 (... ثم أقرأ | أعبر شفويا كما في المثال), 739, 748, 770, 903. Each of these has a rubric that recurs verbatim elsewhere as its own paragraph, which is the proof that they are two items and not one long instruction. (9) Word-bank-to-rubric and word-bank-to-question seams are also hi — 676, 713, 822, 939 — because the banks match paragraph-sized banks elsewhere (⟨929–934⟩, ⟨801–802⟩). But I refuse to cut INSIDE a bank: معلمتي الغصن ألعاب الباحة and سحور خليل أخي خميس ... stay whole, on the paragraph evidence. (10) ⟨823–834⟩ كلمات بها حرف ج / ح / خ are three column headers of the sorting table. They are parallel and disjoint, so I cut 826, 830, 834 — but at med, because they are table furniture and no header of this type stands alone anywhere in the document to back me up. Same reservation, same verdict, for the four choice items at ⟨875–886⟩ (هذا وردة قمر | هذه كتاب قصة | أنا مجتهد مبتكرون | نحن أذكياء مبدع): stem plus two options, four times over, so 877, 880, 883 at med. (11) ⟨859–867⟩ أحب مدرستي وأحافظ على نظافتها | وفي السلة أضع الفضلات. A و-initial clause could be a mere comma continuation, so this needed an argument. The argument is ⟨752–780⟩, where the parallel passage puts وفي غرفة الحاسوب نفكر ونبدع and وفي الحافلة نجلس في نظام on separate display lines: in this text a fronted وفي adverbial starts a new item. Cut 863 at med, and by the same reading 755, 759, 770 at hi. (12) The rhymed class passage ⟨231–271⟩ is syntactically transparent — صفي جميل فسيح ومرتب | في مكتبة الصف كتب مفيدة وقصص ممتعة | وحاسوب جديد وصور ملونة | نرسم في الصف العلم بالألوان | نبني البرج بعلب وعيدان | نقرأ الحروف والكلمات وننشد أحلى ألحان — each a complete predication carrying its own rhyme word. 235, 247, 257, 269 all hi. (13) Title-into-rubric merges I take at med, because a bare heading is the class I am least sure this corpus segments off: 185 (صفي, lesson 2's title), 281 (الدرس الثالث before معلمي و معلمتي), 548 (الوطن, a value/section label trailing the three values statements), 552 and 554 (الدرس الثالث | هذا أنف | أكمل وفق المثال), 582 and 583 (نشيد يا مدرستي | أتحدث). Against that, 228 is hi: أتحدث مع معلمي بأدب is the third of three parallel example sentences (⟨214–218⟩, ⟨220–223⟩) and the trailing صفي is the next section's title — a completed example plus a stray title is not one sentence. Likewise 567 (معلمون معلم closes the singular/plural table, then القصة الرافدة opens), 666 and 748, all hi. أنا تلميذ / نحن تلاميذ at ⟨559–562⟩ are complete nominal sentences, so 560 and 562, med. SITES I DELIBERATELY LEFT UNCUT, and why. ⟨214⟩ المثال stays attached to أتعلم في صف واسع — label plus colon, and a colon is not a terminator. ⟨176–180⟩, ⟨273–278⟩ and ⟨568–575⟩: القصة الرافدة plus story title plus قصصي الممتعة is one caption, and ⟨568–575⟩ proves it by spelling the link out as من كتاب قصصي الممتعة. ⟨362–369⟩ and ⟨371–376⟩: فالمعلمة كالأم and والمعلم كالأب are explanatory continuations of بارك الله فيكما and أحسنتما, comma-grade, one sentence each; they are also exactly parallel to each other, so treating them alike is the disciplined choice. ⟨904–918⟩ أبحث عن عشر كلمات ... أكتبها بخط جميل وأقرؤها في الصف is a single multi-step rubric whose steps hang off one task, so I cut only at 903 where the preceding question ends. And ⟨112–119⟩, ⟨344–350⟩, ⟨533–542⟩ are single clause chains coordinated by و with no second predication head — left whole. CONFIDENCE POLICY for this first batch: hi where a completed predication or a verbatim-attested item type abuts another; med where the item count is certain but the seam or the unit type lacks standalone attestation (headings, table furniture, verse hemistichs, blanked exercise items); lo reserved for 287, the single cut I would drop first if told I am over-segmenting. All 117 paragraph-final positions and the final token are included at hi and untouched; 60 of the 178 boundaries are my own internal calls, of which 31 are hi, 28 med, 1 lo. If the grader tells me this document is over-segmented, the med block is where I retreat: headings first (185, 281, 287, 288, 335, 337, 548, 552, 554, 582, 583), then table furniture (826, 830, 834, 877, 880, 883), then hemistichs (615, 619, 624, 628, 648, 657, 660). If it tells me I am under-segmented, the places I held back are 214 (المثال), the القصة الرافدة captions, the speaker labels, and 912 / 366 / 373.
